description: Java Spring Boot REST controller class providing reporting endpoints for admin dashboards, including claims summary and premiums aggregated data.

classes.name: ReportingController
classes.description: A REST controller providing insurance reporting endpoints for administrative use, including claims summary and premiums report.

methods.description: Generates a report aggregating total premiums collected and the number of premium payments.
